requiredInputs.publicOptions: Existing publicConfiguration exact DEV URL/publishable key

requiredInputs.noteAuth/noteCore: Sanitized metadata only; never tokens, OTP, raw mail or headers

stages.action: Verify exact execution qualification before any OTP; no inherited old window/approval
stages.stopIf: Missing scope, wrong hash/target, old or expired window, resource conflict, quota unavailable/429

stages.assert: CREATE_ITEM/P1/MANUAL enabled; exact active A-Person; new Item absent, new operation unattempted. Receipt404 alone never proves historical NoCommit

stages.action: Exclusive fsynced ATTEMPT.json before the first POST; never delete after logout; repeat reservation fails closed

stages.wire: Exact WIRE_BODY.json; one physical POST including automatic401 retry protection; current qualifier rechecked at wire boundary

stages.action: Existing transport validates immutable receipt hash/scope/operation/intent. Require FULL APPLIED and exactly one created ITEM 1a0d7aa8-11d3-4e88-9599-dd5d4d68f6ee
stages.onResponseLoss: One GET of same new operation only, no second POST, no alternate operation

stages.action: Independent normal collection; then own local logout and refresh rejection before B session
One normal existing-account OTP/getUser; only collection GET; exact B-Person and same Item/revision/Owner/visibility/family/title/description/date/participation
Own local logout + refresh rejection; return only truthful shared-item/member result
stages.notClaimed: No qualified private Item fixture is not private-isolation PASS; no Native cold/OwnerUX/Revoke PASS

recovery.preconditions: Separate lawful read qualification and own normal Session; no auto read/OTP rerun
recovery.fullApplied: Exact receipt plus exact A Item readback required; later B read separate
recovery.conflictRejectedNoChange: Report actual immutable terminal outcome; never overwrite/retry under new ID
recovery.reservation: Keep ATTEMPT.json across cleanup/crash; absence of session lock is not business replay permission

neverInvoke: Old shared/private fixture command list, Invite/Claim/Revoke, Provider/Source/OAuth/SQL/role/config mutation

cleanup.authority: Only current run proven Session; scope=local then refresh rejection
cleanup.noProvenIdentity: Never revoke another Session/admin cleanup; retain uncertain QA lease
cleanup.onFailure: Stop, persist operation/receipt/attempt and local cleanup state; no automatic OTP, B session or business retry
cleanup.noDeletion: Do not delete Trip, created Item, Person, historical receipt or reservation as cleanup
